_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to slack-experts.json (gitignored) and fill in real Slack member IDs. Get an ID in Slack: profile → ••• → Copy member ID (looks like U0123ABCD). The LLM picks an 'areas' tag from the keys below; the program maps each area to member IDs (skill = fan out to everyone with that skill; members = explicit list). ALLOWLIST: only escalations that resolve to a routed owner are posted to Slack — anything uncategorized (Triage, or no match) is SKIPPED entirely.

Engine.hint: engine runtime, pipeline execution, node crashes, client↔engine connection failures

Infra.hint: deployment, Docker engine image, hosting, CI infrastructure

Deps.hint: dependency/build constraint issues (onnxruntime, package pin conflicts, nodes:build)

TS.hint: TypeScript SDK, app-sdk packaging, VSCode/Cursor extension behavior

Python.hint: Python version support and Python SDK questions — tag EVERYONE who knows Python

Integration.hint: how to use/build/integrate RocketRide, getting started, connectors

Ops.hint: accounts, login, OTP, developer id, access provisioning, Cloud key enablement, billing

Triage.hint: no-fit sink — use when NOTHING else fits: events/hackathons, business/partnership/press/investor topics, a lone greeting, or text with no usable signal (image-only, bare email). Resolves to no owner, so the escalation is SKIPPED (not posted to Slack).
